description: Changes and exceptions are not managed, assessed for risk impact, and tracked.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Risk assessment and vulnerability management teams Security operations and threat intelligence functions Organizations conducting security assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: This signal indicates that change management processes do not include risk assessment steps, or that policy exceptions and deviations are not evaluated for risk impact. Organizations should integrate risk assessment into change management workflows and establish exception tracking and review processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
